data.title: 霍尔海雅 · 茶罐里的标签
data.description: 她从架子上取下一只茶罐，把标签从头读到尾，笑着问店主这款茶的名字是谁取的。
data.action: 拿起一只茶罐阅读标签
data.camera: 中近景，茶罐和标签可见
data.promptProse: In a wooden tea merchant's apothecary lined with rows of small apothecary drawers, Ho'olheyak lifts a painted lacquer tea tin, reading the calligraphic label with curious delight. Sunbeams piercing through vintage window glass illuminate jars of dried tea leaves, brass weighing scales, and ceramic canisters in the warm boutique.
